name: guardrails
description: Mechanical safety guards for agents: hooks that refuse a dangerous command and tell the agent what to do instead. Guards: no inline node/bun eval (-e, -p), which turns any library that forks with execArgv into a fork bomb; no package install inside a git submodule whose packages are workspaces of the superproject, which shadows its dependencies; no command that prints a secret value into the transcript (an env dump under secrets run, a keychain read, the store token, bws secret get); and a warning when a session starts below its repository's root, where the project's skills do not load
